summary: Wrote a single-phase, documentation-only plan for adding a `## Building a single file` subsection to CONTRIBUTING.md, placed last under `# Continuous Integration` immediately after `## Imports`, plus the required hand-maintained Table of Contents entry. The plan specifies a symptom-first content shape (hang signature, rule, one-sentence `--setup` mechanism, two secondary hazards, optional escape hatch) sized to match the terse register of the adjacent subsections. Scope is one file; verification is prose-tier and explicitly forbids running the diverging command.
decisions_made: Doc home is CONTRIBUTING.md's `# Continuous Integration` section; new subsection titled `## Building a single file`, placed last, immediately after `## Imports`.
The hand-maintained Table of Contents entry `  - [Building a single file](#building-a-single-file)` is an in-scope, required companion edit, not optional polish.
Sized as one phase (~0.5 h): documentation-only, single file, no dependencies.
Content is symptom-first so a contributor mid-hang can pattern-match before reading the cause.
scripts/README.md's `AxiomCensus.lean` `lake env lean --run` usage is a distinct SAFE pattern and must not be cited alongside the hazard.
The diverging command is never run during implementation or verification; all technical figures are restated from the prior stall investigation's measurements.
